mathematical_scope: Full 249-line exact positive-sign finite-field Fourier executor for powers of two with 8<=B<N<=B², L=N/B. It builds L independent B-point FFTs, folds even frequencies by dyadic butterflies, gathers residual rows according to multiplication-by-(1+B) orbits, then performs orbit FFTs with phase factors. The displayed geometric-sum formula supports the sparse residual oracle. The final count is exactly N log2(N)/2 butterflies; source explicitly says no speedup. The finite field has 2-power roots only through 2^23.
input_and_guard_coverage: root checks power-of-two n and n|(P-1), then exact order. precompute_residual checks structural N,B range, but does not check root(N) at the start: unsupported larger N may do substantial work before orbit_finish requests its N-th root. fft_radix2 asserts nonempty power-of-two length. orbits, orbit_finish, sparse_residual_oracle and direct_dft are public helpers with fewer guards; orbit_finish only checks y length and total consumed, not disjoint/exhaustive/valid cycle indices or canonical orbit order. Invalid B=0 can divide by zero. All major invariants are assert statements and disappear under -O.
cost_and_scaling: FFT bank N log2(B)/2 butterflies, folding (N-B)/2, orbit total B/2+N(log2 L-1)/2; together classical count. All retained dyadic spectra sum to <2N entries, cycles O(N), output O(N), roots cached without a size/count eviction cap. Phase tables and scalar twiddles are additional work outside the butterfly counter. Sparse oracle loops N output rows by N input indices, O(N²) predicate checks, and uses modular exponentiation on selected entries. Direct DFT uses N² exponentiations. Fixed-modulus finite implementation is not itself an asymptotic unbounded-N field family.
test_evidence: Phase15 suite checks random residuals, selected zero/one/alternating/geometric/impulse inputs, exact counts, same-helper FFT equality, inverses and numerical Gram. Main checks direct DFT/sparse oracle through N=1024 and shared-helper FFT at N=2048; separate large_smoke reaches N=16384. These are intended checks, not runs in this audit. Small direct DFT is the stronger independent algorithmic oracle.
dependency_identity: Standard library only: Counter (unused), dataclass and lru_cache. Three assigned consumers rely on this exact hash. Bare imports and execution environment remain unpinned.

findings.finding: Externally supplied cycles can duplicate or omit output labels while still consuming exactly N input elements. The helper lacks a permutation/disjoint-cover guard; correctness requires canonical cycles from orbits(N,B).
The public structural parameter guard admits N beyond the available fixed-field root range, which is rejected only later in the full pipeline. Early root-domain validation would prevent wasted work.
Butterfly conservation is an architecture accounting result, not a lower bound on all FFT implementations. It already rules out a speedup claim for this concrete butterfly decomposition.

acceptance_boundary: Accept as an auditable finite-field folded FFT design with conserved classical work, subject to canonical helper inputs. No tests, import, compilation or actual transform evaluation were performed here.
